about_the_game:
Breeze of Ashes is a unique blend of real-time strategy and rogue-lite elements, challenging players to build, adapt, and command fleets in a world of shifting alliances and relentless warfare. The game offers deep tactical gameplay with emergent storytelling, where every decision shapes the course of battle and long-term survival.

Core Gameplay Loop

At the start of each mission, players establish their initial base in a brief but crucial preparation phase. The available construction options depend on the selected map, game mode, and campaign progress. In campaign mode, an ongoing rivalry unfolds between the player and their primary opposition, featuring dynamic interactions, taunts, and story progression. In skirmish mode, players receive a set budget to construct their base before combat begins.

Construction is entirely focused on war. Players can fortify their base with walls, deploy turrets, or construct imposing castles to establish control over the battlefield. Fleets form the backbone of engagements, and in the campaign, a persistent fleet carries over between missions, allowing players to develop long-term strategies.

Overcoming Challenges

Each map presents a different set of challenges and objectives, some offering unrestricted access to a full arsenal of tools, while others demand creative problem-solving. Players might need to coordinate with AI forces, augment allies, or utilize diplomacy to achieve victory. Strategy must be constantly refined to tackle different mission structures and enemy tactics.

Upgrade System & Fleet Customization

Units can be upgraded mid-mission, providing multiple upgrade paths that allow players to fine-tune their forces to match their playstyle or counteract enemy threats. Capital ships feature extensive customization options, including specialized weapon platforms, production enhancements, defensive modifications, and powerful active abilities.

Augmenting Allies

In the heat of battle, players can transfer capabilities from their flagship to allied units, reinforcing their offense or defense. This allows for dynamic battlefield tactics, strengthening crucial allies or creating specialized support units.

Campaign: Rescuing Civilians at a Cost

The campaign presents a high-stakes challenge: converting parts of your fleet into a civilian evacuation force. Throughout your journey, you must decide how much of your combat power to sacrifice to rescue survivors. Each run consists of a set number of steps—if you reach the final step without having saved enough people, the run is lost. However, failure is not the end. Players retain unlocked technologies across playthroughs, allowing them to experiment with different faction combinations and strategies in future attempts.

Diplomacy and rival factions play a key role in shaping the game's world. Players can form alliances, assist other factions in their missions, and deploy agents to undermine their enemies. Opposing factions may also form their own coalitions, creating evolving battle scenarios with shifting power dynamics.

Expansive Content

Breeze of Ashes features a campaign mode alongside 7+ unique game modes, each containing six missions with distinct objectives and challenges. Campaign mode allows players to navigate a branching narrative, engaging in diplomacy, world-building, and technology development, all while balancing military strength against humanitarian efforts.

Multiplayer & Mod Support

Multiplayer remains a core feature, delivering intense strategic battles against other players. Additionally, mod support allows players to craft their own maps and modify or add new units, expanding the game's strategic possibilities and replayability.

With its dynamic battles, evolving campaign, and deep customization, Breeze of Ashes offers an RTS experience where every decision matters. Prepare your fleet, forge alliances, and face the ever-changing tides of war.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: 2.3 Ghz to 2.69 Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: 2.3 Ghz to 2.69 Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Command airships in a tactical RTS where choices shape your story. Manage resources, upgrade your fleet, and battle rival factions in a non-linear campaign. With rogue-lite replayability, multiplayer co-op, and skirmish modes, your journey evolves with every playthrough.
